# Clackamas Coot's mix  (0.25× batch)
# Clackamas Coot. The reference recipe for the no-till / living-soil side of the hobby.
# source: https://growingorganic.com/soil-guide/coots-soil-mix/
# batch: per cubic foot of finished mix

## base
  1 part  sphagnum peat moss
  1 part  compost or worm castings
  1 part  aeration — pumice, lava rock or rice hulls

## amendments
  4 tbsp  kelp meal
  2 tbsp  neem seed meal
  2 tbsp  karanja meal
  2–4 tbsp  flax seed meal
  4 tbsp  fine agricultural lime
  2 tbsp  gypsum
  12 tbsp–1 cup  rock dust

## cook
  Four to six weeks, kept damp. Some growers then top-dress a quarter cup of freshly ground malted barley a week from week three.

## watch out
  The recipe leans entirely on the compost. The sources are unanimous that poor compost sinks the whole mix, and that is the ingredient hardest to judge by eye.

# Transcribed from the source above without adjustment. A grower recipe,
# not an agronomic standard: no soil test, no control, no replication.
